submission.justification: Radiator-R2 at 2 cm thickness provides the highest pion/kaon separation (4.435) at 10 GeV/c among all tested options and thicknesses. This maximizes the detector's identification power. All constraints are respected: Radiator-R2 is among the allowed candidates, the optimal thickness (2 cm) is within the permissible 1–6 cm range, and project documents confirm that R2 passes the <10% transparency loss after 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing. No data suggest any failure of the requirements for this option.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c.
requirements.evidence: Separation for R2 at 2 cm is 4.435, the highest among all radiator/thickness combinations tested.

requirements.requirement: The radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Radiator-R2 is one of the three specified candidates.

requirements.requirement: Transparency loss after a 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing test must not exceed 10%.
requirements.evidence: Project documents confirm R2 passes the humidity ageing requirement with under 10% transparency loss.
Selected thickness, 2 cm, lies within the required 1–6 cm range.
